description: Get detailed variant information with optional sections. Core data (id, gene, rsid, significance) is always returned at the top level. Use sections to request additional data. Response section keys mirror the requested section names: sections:["alphagenome_scores"] returns sections.alphagenome_scores — the legacy storage key (alphagenome) never appears in responses.

id.description: Variant ID (rsid e.g. rs113488022, HGVS e.g. NM_004333.4:c.1799T>A, ClinVar ID e.g. 13961 / clinvar_13961 / VCV0000013961). Multi-allelic rsIDs (one ClinVar allele per ALT, e.g. rs28934575): the top-level record is ONE allele, chosen by gnomad-availability — all alleles are returned under 'alleles' with a '_warning' naming the reflected allele; to select an exact allele use allele-qualified HGVS (e.g. NM_000546.5:c.733G>T), where the transcript version must match the indexed snpeff annotation (NM_000546.5 works; ClinVar's NM_000546.6 does not)

sections.description: Sections to include: core, frequency, predictions, clinical, alphagenome_scores (currently unavailable — returns an error stub pending AlphaGenome gRPC reimplementation)

name: variant_get
